name: Pygmy hippopotamus
desc: A secretive forest hippo that eats ferns, herbs and fallen fruit. Wikipedia lists Taï as one of the few areas holding it in Côte d'Ivoire.
about: The pygmy hippopotamus or pygmy hippo is a small hippopotamid which is native to the forests and swamps of West Africa, primarily in Liberia, with small populations in Sierra Leone, Guinea, and Ivory…
